description:
The story of Moana is rooted in the rich culture of the islands of Oceania. Folk tales and legends are part of the very fabric of that culture. The Introduction -- The Story of Te Fiti which sets the context for the story of Moana -- is one such tale. The author includes several short folk tales interspersed throughout the book. 

This story precedes chapter 3 and tells the tale of a brother with two siblings and the beauty of kindness and sharing.
